# jipcode

**Tag**: filesystem, data

## 简介

A gem for Japan Post's official zipcode data search & update.

## 官网

- 主页: https://github.com/rinkei/jipcode
- 文档: https://www.rubydoc.info/gems/jipcode/3.4.4
- RubyGems: https://rubygems.org/gems/jipcode
